# Footprint

<!-- GENERATED by `make generate` from src/catalog: DO NOT EDIT -->

Everything `station` and the catalogue's tools write on a machine, by Disk group: what an erase would lose. The groups, the relocation rule and the commands that free, erase and move are [Disk](disk.md)'s.

| Group         | Who removes it                                                                          |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| misplaced     | `station disk move <folder>` moves it where its app's own config says, with no question |
| can rebuild   | `station disk free`, with no question                                                   |
| your data     | `station disk erase <app>`, its name typed                                              |
| never touched | nobody: keys, tokens, settings and VM records; a setting's `off` where reversible       |

Paths under `~/.config`, `~/.local/share`, `~/.local/state` and `~/.cache` follow their `XDG_*_HOME` variable when it is set and absolute. A path marked mac lives on a host and a macOS VM; linux, on a Linux VM; vm, in every VM and never on a host; host, on a host only.

## Station

| Path                                                       | Group         | Note                                                                                                                                                                |
| ---------------------------------------------------------- | ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `~/.cache/station`                                         | can rebuild   | downloaded station binaries (`station-linux-arm64`) and the last-known sizes a read shows until its walk answers; `sizes.json` rewritten on every call, not counted |
| `~/.local/state/station/logs/*.log`                        | can rebuild   | `engine.log`, each VM's run `<vm>.log`, `station-build-<image>.log`, `setup.log`, `apps.log`                                                                        |
| `~/.local/state/station/images/askpass`                    | can rebuild   | 0700, the base image's admin password an earlier build left: no build writes it now, `disk free` removes it                                                         |
| `~/.local/state/station/dns/quad9-dns.mobileconfig`        | can rebuild   | regenerated by the dns item                                                                                                                                         |
| `~/.local/share/station/vms/vms/*`                         | your data     | station's VMs and images: `station machines delete`, `station images delete`                                                                                        |
| `~/.local/state/station/images/*/*.json`                   | your data     | image records, paired with their images                                                                                                                             |
| `~/.local/state/station/known_hosts/*`                     | your data     | pins: deleting them downgrades to trust-on-first-use, never cleaned                                                                                                 |
| `~/.local/state/station/consoles/*`                        | your data     | live while a VM or a build runs: `consoles/<vm>`, `consoles/station-build-<image>`                                                                                  |
| `~/.local/state/station/engine.sock`                       | your data     | the engine's socket, live while it runs                                                                                                                             |
| `~/.local/state/station/children/*`                        | your data     | the engine's `tailscale` calls in flight, `<pid>` holding its start: the next engine start kills what a killed one left                                             |
| `~/.local/state/station/runs/*`                            | your data     | each running VM's `<vm>.pid` and `<vm>.exit`                                                                                                                        |
| `~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.jterrazz.station.engine.plist` | never touched | host; the one engine's launchd agent                                                                                                                                |
| `~/.config/station/preferences.json`                       | never touched | here, hosts, vm_user, the share list, the ports policy                                                                                                              |
| `~/.config/station/services.env`                           | never touched | vm; its profiles' exports, written by the guest                                                                                                                     |
| `~/.local/state/station/guest.json`                        | your data     | vm; the host that runs it                                                                                                                                           |
| `~/.local/state/station/guest.sock`                        | your data     | vm; the guest's socket, live while it runs                                                                                                                          |
| `~/.zshrc`                                                 | never touched | the one managed block                                                                                                                                               |
| `~/.ssh/config`                                            | never touched | one Host block per fleet machine                                                                                                                                    |
| `~/.local/state/station/vms/*.json`                        | never touched | VM records: do not delete                                                                                                                                           |
| `~/.local/state/station/images/key*`                       | never touched | the only way into a fresh VM: do not delete                                                                                                                         |
| `~/.local/state/station/leases.json`                       | never touched | the services' host ports: deleting it changes every URL                                                                                                             |
| `~/.local/bin/station`                                     | installed     | removed by `station apps remove`                                                                                                                                    |

The keychain service `station` holds nothing since round 5: `station setup` removed the three tailnet accounts the earlier rounds kept there. It also retired round 3's per-VM launchd agents, `~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.jterrazz.station.vm.*.plist`: booted out and removed, the one engine runs every VM.

## Home-root exceptions

What a tool keeps at the root of the home folder, declared with its reason; anything else there is a stray.

| Path               | Reason                                                                |
| ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `~/.ssh`           | the owner's keys and ssh config                                       |
| `~/.gnupg`         | the owner's GPG keys                                                  |
| `~/.cargo`         | rust-analyzer started by a GUI IDE would lose the toolchain           |
| `~/.rustup`        | rust-analyzer started by a GUI IDE would lose the toolchain           |
| `~/.claude`        | Claude Code reads no config file for its home                         |
| `~/.codex`         | Codex reads no config file for its home                               |
| `~/.zshrc`         | a dotfile                                                             |
| `~/.npmrc`         | a dotfile: npm's own config                                           |
| `~/.gitconfig`     | a dotfile                                                             |
| `~/.bunfig.toml`   | a dotfile: bun's global config                                        |
| `~/.tmux.conf`     | a dotfile                                                             |
| `~/.hushlogin`     | a dotfile                                                             |
| `~/.claude.json`   | a dotfile                                                             |
| `~/.zsh_history`   | a dotfile                                                             |
| `~/.zcompdump*`    | a dotfile: zsh's completion dump                                      |
| `~/.oh-my-zsh`     | relocated by ZSH only, a shell variable (open question 48)            |
| `~/.gemini`        | no config file relocates it (open question 48)                        |
| `~/.pulumi`        | relocated by PULUMI_HOME only (open question 48)                      |
| `~/.terraform.d`   | no config file relocates it (open question 48)                        |
| `~/.ansible`       | relocated by ANSIBLE_HOME only (open question 48)                     |
| `~/.kube`          | relocated by KUBECONFIG only (open question 48)                       |
| `~/.expo`          | no config file relocates it (open question 48)                        |
| `~/.agents`        | the skills CLI's home, no config file relocates it (open question 48) |
| `~/.cocoapods`     | relocated by CP_HOME_DIR only (open question 48)                      |
| `~/.gradle`        | relocated by GRADLE_USER_HOME only (open question 48)                 |
| `~/.android`       | relocated by ANDROID_USER_HOME only (open question 48)                |
| `~/.ollama`        | relocated by OLLAMA_MODELS only (open question 48)                    |
| `~/.orbstack`      | OrbStack's own home (open question 48)                                |
| `~/.docker`        | relocated by DOCKER_CONFIG only (open question 48)                    |
| `~/.agent-browser` | no config file relocates it (open question 48)                        |
| `~/.hermes`        | no config file relocates it (open question 48)                        |

## Relocations

Written by `station setup` into the tool's own file, never by a shell variable.

| Tool | File        | Key                     | Value                               | Status  |
| ---- | ----------- | ----------------------- | ----------------------------------- | ------- |
| bun  | bunfig      | `install.globalDir`     | `~/.local/share/bun/install/global` | written |
| bun  | bunfig      | `install.globalBinDir`  | `~/.local/share/bun/bin`            | written |
| bun  | bunfig      | `install.cache.dir`     | `~/.cache/bun/install`              | written |
| go   | go-env      | `GOPATH`                | `~/.local/share/go`                 | written |
| go   | go-env      | `GOMODCACHE`            | `~/.cache/go/mod`                   | written |
| go   | mise config | `settings.go_set_gobin` | `false`                             | written |
| node | npmrc       | `cache`                 | `~/.cache/npm`                      | written |
